name: framing spell
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Framing spell is a Scottish magical belief. To cross two threads, in the manner used when a loom wove them together, served now and then in Scotland as a spell. The source stores no fuller detail.

okr.objective: A framing spell is a Scottish magical act made by crossing threads.
key_results: A framing spell crossed two threads as on a loom.
The practice counted once in a while as a spell in Scotland.
The source records no fuller detail.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
